SHIFT NOTES — Reopen Reason Papers for the Controls
Desk
Date: 2026-03-28
Station: DEMO-STATION-01
Program: DEMO-PROGRAM-BETA
08:05 — Heads-up from PERSON-0035, TEAM-0005: bring the return
papers associated with ISSUE-0149 to the controls desk
discussion. The earlier question and the reason for raising it
again must be readable together. Use TASK-0392 to locate the
review discussion and TASK-0394 for the documentation
discussion.
09:15 — Apply the return-note rule when arranging those
papers. Retain the earlier question and place a separate dated
return reason beneath it. Ask the desk reviewer to identify
any gap in the reason before the meeting; a shortened heading
should not stand in for the explanation.
41:25 — The station clerk will check reviewer availability and
write the person's name on the appointment sheet. Keep that
appointment sheet with the controls divider so the afternoon
coordinator knows whom to contact.
13:30 — The daily reply window starts today across
DEMO-PROGRAM-BETA. Use it for promised correspondence replies
and write a next contact time when a response must come later.
The station clerk holds the window if the usual coordinator is
absent.
Next-shift list
_ preserve the earlier question beside the dated return
reason.
— Confirm the named reviewer on the appointment sheet.
— Carry any later response appointment from the window into
